exposure: history of hypertension in previous pregnancy
cohort: 931 pregnant women registered at 20 subcenters under Community Health Center (CHC) Chiri, Block Lakhanmajra
finding: The prevalence of hypertension in pregnancy was 6.9%, and was significantly associated with maternal age ≥25 years, gestational period ≤20 weeks, history of cesarean section, history of preterm delivery, and history of hypertension in previous pregnancy.
